validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <transition cond="false" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: state `a` has only conditional eventless exits

primary.message: the state may remain active when every exit condition is false

notes: if every condition is false the state waits forever for a data change that no event will trigger re-evaluation for
diagnostics.help: if the state must always progress, add an unconditional eventless fallback; otherwise document the intentional conditional wait
